run_asr_json_prep: run the asr_prep_json script to convert audio files and labels into a fairseq JSON dataset
process_sample_audio: process a single audio sample by extracting duration and tokenizing its label with sentencepiece
encode_labels_with_spm: encode speech recognition labels into subword tokens using a sentencepiece model
encode_tokens_with_dictionary: encode sentencepiece tokens into fairseq dictionary token IDs for ASR training
parallel_process_audio_samples: parallel process multiple audio samples using ThreadPoolExecutor to build a JSON dataset
